hidden.description: Hidden achievements show no description until unlocked.

icon.description: Store icon (the coloured one when unlocked, the grey one when locked).

rarityPercent.description: Share of players who unlocked it, 0–100; null if unknown.

AppErrorPayload.description: Error shape of every rejected Tauri command.

CatalogCredentials.description: Credentials entered in Settings; stored in the OS keyring, never returned to the UI.

libraryGameId.description: Library game linked to this catalogue entry, if any.

offline.description: True when the provider was unreachable and cached data is shown.

reasons.description: Recommendation reasons by game id (sort "recommended" with the recommender running; else empty).

total.description: Total number of matches, null if the provider does not report it.

useCoveService.description: Use the Cove catalogue service (no own API keys needed).

CatalogSource.description: Where catalogue data comes from, in fallback order.

configured.description: Own credentials stored in the keyring.

online.description: False after the last request failed for network reasons.

sources.description: Sources in the order they are tried; empty = catalogue not available.

ConnectableStore.description: Stores that support account connections (everything except manual).

error.description: Null on success and when the user cancelled.

ConnectorLoginMode.description: How the login page is shown: system browser (loopback redirect) or an own window.

ConnectorLoginStart.description: Answer of `connector_login_start`; the result arrives as `connector-login-finished`.

fallbackUrl.description: Alternative login (Epic): open this page in any browser and paste the shown code into Cove (`connector_login_complete`).

CoveAchievement.description: Cove's own achievements, evaluated locally (definitions: JSON, plugins can add more).

available.description: This build knows a proxy URL.

enabled.description: The user has not switched it off.

DirectDownloadInput.description: A direct link (DRM-free game, mod, patch).

title.description: Library title; null = derived from the file name.

checksumVerified.description: True once the SHA-256 matched the expected value.

installPath.description: Game folder after a successful install.

queuePosition.description: Position in the queue (0-based) for active/queued items, null otherwise.

DownloadItem.description: Download joined with its game metadata.

DownloadOrigin.description: Where a download comes from. Store games are never downloaded by Cove itself.

DownloadProgress.description: Event `download-progress`, at most about 4 per second and download.

bandwidthLimitBytesPerSecond.description: Bandwidth limit in bytes/second, null = unlimited.

Game.description: Catalogue metadata for a game (independent of whether the user owns it).

description.description: Full description, plain text with `\n\n` between paragraphs.

features.description: Extra descriptors for the recommender; null when the source does not provide them.

releaseDate.description: Null when unknown (e.g. unreleased or manually added games).

header.description: Wide header / hero image, 16:9 or wider.

GameId.description: Stable game identifier (store-independent, assigned by the core).

sessionSeconds.description: Length of the finished session in seconds; null while running.

ImageRef.description: Reference to an image. `url` is null when no artwork is available yet.

ItchGame.description: An itch.io game the user owns (or a free one).

downloadKeyId.description: Purchase key; null for free games.

arguments.description: Extra command-line arguments, as typed by the user.

compatibilityTool.description: Linux only: how Windows binaries are run.

tracked.description: False when Cove cannot observe the game (started via a store client without known install folder).

LibraryEntry.description: A game in the user's library.

catalogId.description: Linked catalogue entry (e.g. `igdb-1942`), null if not matched.

executablePath.description: Absolute path of the file Cove starts (.exe, binary, AppImage, .desktop, script).

installPath.description: Absolute path of the install directory, null if not installed.

installSizeBytes.description: Size on disk in bytes, null if not installed.

storeGameId.description: Store-specific id (e.g. Steam app id) used for URL-scheme launches; null for manual games.

LibraryItem.description: Library entry joined with its game metadata — what list views render.

LibraryUpdate.description: Partial update of a library entry; omitted fields stay unchanged.

LocalStoreGame.description: A game installed on this computer, found without login.

ManualGameInput.description: Input for adding a game manually.

sizeBytes.description: Known size on disk (from a folder scan), null if unknown.

MatchStatus.description: Catalogue matching state of a library game: none = not matched (yet) · pending = suggestions wait for the user · matched = metadata applied · rejected = user declined all suggestions.

days.description: One entry per day, oldest first (no gaps).

executablePath.description: Null adds the game without install (Cove looks up catalogue data).

entryUrl.description: Module URL for the worker; only for active plugins.

removable.description: Installed into Cove's plugin folder (development plugins cannot be removed here).

PluginManifestPreview.description: `plugin.json` of a folder the user wants to install (shown in the permission dialog).

alreadyInstalled.description: An older version is installed already (it will be replaced).

PluginPermission.description: What a plugin may do. The user confirms them when installing.

PluginStatus.description:
- `active`: approved and enabled, runs in its own worker
- `disabled`: approved, switched off by the user
- `needsApproval`: new, or an update asks for more permissions
- `invalid`: `plugin.json` is broken (see `error`)

ProxyError.description: Body of every non-2xx proxy response.

ProxyMatchResponse.description: `POST /v1/match` — best catalogue candidates for a title, best first.

private.description: True when Steam hides the games (profile or "game details" private).

public.description: False when the profile is private (library and achievements are hidden).

reason.description: Short human-readable reason, e.g. "Weil du Tidewater gespielt hast".

RecommenderGame.description: A catalogue game as the recommender sees it (content features + prior).

RecommenderLibraryGame.description: A library game as the recommender sees it (interaction signals).

gameId.description: Catalogue id when linked, otherwise the library game id.

ScanCandidate.description: A game found while scanning a folder (suggestion — the user confirms).

sizeBytes.description: Size of the game folder in bytes.

ServiceStatus.description: Health of a component. Sidecars start on first use, so `idle` is normal.

connected.description: True while a login is stored (also when it needs to be renewed).

gameCount.description: Number of games imported from this store.

helpUrl.description: Where the user can fix it (e.g. Steam privacy settings).

SyncProgress.description: Event `store-sync-progress` while a background sync runs.

available.description: `null` when Cove is up to date.

canInstall.description: `false` for `.deb`/`.rpm` installs: the package manager updates those.
